color_count: Only used colours with role, relationship, region and area reasons; independent of solution count.
method_selection: Current-model authored, object-specific; no fixed recipe or index selection.

repair.unregistered_tool_calls: tracked by host, not observable by CLI

fidelity: Only explicit faithful_recolor with author-specified max_d100, observed source RGB and user evidence.
typography: Actual observed reading targets/states require coverage. Computable digital normal text >=4.5, evidenced large text >=3; physical thresholds remain contextual. Retained/variable backgrounds use current-image visual review with contrast:null, never invented palette facts.

visual_gate.acceptance: Actual current image seen, accept decision, applicable checks pass with region evidence, zero unresolved issues.

coverage: All observed elements require a disposition; every painted region must map to a recolored element. Retained visual associations do not count as recoloring or consume palette area.
